keyVerseDR: "If any of you want wisdom, let him ask of God, who giveth to all men abundantly." (Jas 1:5)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Perspective
level1.story: Perspective means seeing the big picture and making wise choices. We can ask God for wisdom anytime!
level1.keyLine: God, help me see the big picture.
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice perspective all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What helped us see the big picture this week?
What good advice did someone give us?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Lord, give me wisdom. Help me see what matters most and choose what is good. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Ask God for wisdom when you wake up
TUE: Think: Will this matter tomorrow?
WED: Ask a parent for advice on a choice
THU: Give a friend kind, helpful advice
FRI: Remember a hard day that turned out fine
SAT: Thank God for His big, good plan

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Perspective
level2.story: Perspective is a wise way of seeing the world and making important decisions. It means stepping back to see the big picture, thinking about what matters most, and giving good advice. People with perspective remember that God's plan is bigger than one bad day. Saint James says that if we need wisdom, we should ask God, who gives generously.
level2.keyLine: God, help me see the big picture.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice perspective all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What helped us see the big picture this week?
How did God help us grow in perspective?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: Lord, give me wisdom. Help me see what matters most and choose what is good. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Before a big choice, list the good and bad
TUE: Ask an elder what they learned in life
WED: Calm a small problem by seeing the big picture
THU: Give honest advice when someone asks
FRI: Think about what Jesus would choose
SAT: Pray for wisdom for our family

art.mainBrief: A Catholic family practicing perspective together at home
